definitions.explanation: Having the color of snow or milk.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っています→降る：00839_furu⟧。
{白|しろ}い⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ています→着る：00541_kiru⟧。

examples.english: I want my teeth to become white.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白|しろ}い⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I like white flowers. At weddings, many people wear white dresses.

notes:
{白|しろ}い is an i-adjective meaning white.

FORMS:
- Noun form: {白|しろ} (the color white)
- Adverbial: {白|しろ}く ({白|しろ}くなる = to become white)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {白|しろ}い{目|め}で{見|み}る: to look at with cold/critical eyes
- {白|しろ}い{息|いき}: visible breath (in cold weather)
- {白黒|しろくろ}: black and white

CULTURE:
White symbolizes purity and cleanliness in Japan. It's worn at weddings (bride's {白無垢|しろむく}) but also associated with mourning.

CONTRAST:
- {白|しろ}い: white
- {黒|くろ}い: black
